opening.argument: The video presents a practical Office setup walkthrough: it directs viewers to Office.com, shows an install control, and explains signing in, entering a product key, and tying that key to a Microsoft account. Those steps describe ordinary installation and account procedures, while the speaker expressly states that desktop use requires a product key or subscription rather than offering a way to obtain Office for free. The discussion of Office 2007 is likewise a support warning about the absence of security updates. Nothing in these demonstrated flows establishes a deceptive installation mechanism or turns the setup instructions into a financial opportunity.

What will happen then is it will tie that product key to your Microsoft account
